name: skill_manager
description: List all available skills, get details about a specific skill (what it does, what arguments it needs), or search for skills matching a keyword. Useful when the user asks 'what can you do' or 'what skills do you have'.

action.description: list: all available skill names + short descriptions. describe: full details (description, parameters) for one named skill. search: find skills matching a keyword.

skill_name.description: Exact skill name. Required for action='describe'.
